checks.evidence: 2822 candidate financial summaries joined to FEC IDs

checks.evidence: 103 House offices documented (102 general-ballot contests, 1 separately sourced unopposed offices), 3 Senate contests; 332 House offices not yet verified

checks.evidence: No 2024 presidential vote totals adjusted to 2026 House boundaries
